search_text: published ZDI-08-058 ZDI-CAN-356 Apple QuickTime Panorama PDAT Atom Parsing Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2008-09-09 CVE-2008-3625 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-3625 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists in the handling of panorama track PDAT atoms. When the maxTilt, minFieldOfView and maxFieldOfView elements are corrupted, a stack buffer overflow occurs which can be further leveraged to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current user. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
